clue.text: Force member to rip off firm

parts.note: to con someone is to swindle or rip them off
stable means firm, steady

explanation.surface: A police officer is caught trying to swindle a company.
explanation.definitionFit: A police force is made up of officers, the basic rank being this one.

clue.text: Head cook touring India

indicators.note: touring means going around, so cook goes around India

parts.note: a chef is a cook
I is India in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: A head chef makes a culinary tour of India.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader or boss is a head, as in head of department.

clue.text: Clearly defines island, now for development

indicators.note: for development means being worked into something new, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A planning decision marks an island ready for building now.
explanation.definitionFit: To pin something down or settle it precisely is to define it clearly.

clue.text: Berate beastly male following an offensive four-letter word

indicators.note: following puts the berating and the male after the offensive

parts.note: the Tet offensive of the Vietnam War
to rag is to tease or scold
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: Someone scolds an animal after it uses foul language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offensive' and 'four-letter word' suggest swearing, but the definition is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: Any word of four letters, especially the Hebrew name of God, YHWH.

clue.text: Help air surrounding earth in atmospheric enhancement

indicators.note: surrounding says the two words go around the earth

parts.note: to back is to help or support
an air is a tune, music
ground means earth

explanation.surface: Assistance in the air around the earth improves the climate.
explanation.definitionFit: Music played softly behind a scene adds mood or atmosphere.

clue.text: Labour baron sacked after powerless "Iran Empathy" broadcast

indicators.note: after puts the baron's letters behind the others
broadcast means scattered, so the letters are rearranged
powerless means lacking P, the abbreviation for power
sacked means ravaged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sacked Labour peer, unable to lead, empathises with Iran in a broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' looks like the political party but means one of the labours of Hercules; 'powerless' takes P from IRANEMPATHY, 'broadcast' gives ERYMANTHIA, 'sacked' turns BARON into NBOAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Capturing this boar alive was the fourth of the twelve labours of Hercules.

clue.text: Sommelier eschewing one non-alcoholic drink

indicators.note: eschewing means going without, so the letter for one is dropped from the wine server

parts.note: a sommelier is a wine waiter
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A wine waiter on the wagon chooses a soft drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain tap or bottled liquid from the tap is the most basic drink containing no alcohol.

clue.text: Inferior small bore going around

indicators.note: going around says the past tense goes around small

parts.note: bore means wore, as in bore a crown

explanation.surface: A cheap small-bore gun that rotates is of poor quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Lower in quality is the comparative sense of bad.

clue.text: Weight of news in digital form?

indicators.note: in says the news goes inside the digit

parts.note: a toe is a digit of the foot
N is short for new, so news is two Ns

explanation.surface: How much does news weigh once it is digitised?
explanation.definitionFit: A metric unit of mass, a thousand kilograms.

clue.text: Rebel worker buried under refuse

indicators.note: buried under means placed beneath, in a down clue after

parts.note: to resist is to refuse
an ant is a worker insect

explanation.surface: A rebellious worker gets buried under rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refuse' is not rubbish but the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebel opposes authority, and opposing is being defiant or unyielding.

clue.text: Foolish master quits in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: quits says the master's letters leave the phrase for a manner of speaking

parts.note: idiomatic means in the manner of natural speech
MA, Master of Arts, a degree abbreviation

explanation.surface: A teacher walks out, calling the whole affair foolish, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe behaviour that is stupid or senseless; a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Old lady and tiny kids perhaps mentioned underwear

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the words are judged by how they sound

parts.words: Old lady and tiny kids perhaps
parts.note: old lady is slang for a wife, and runts, the smallest of a litter, may be tiny kids: wife runts

explanation.surface: A mother and her little ones talk about underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: Said quickly, 'wife runts' gives the brand-style name for men's briefs with a Y-shaped seam at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: These are men's briefs with an inverted Y seam, a type of underpants.

clue.text: Big cat's back so fluffy, but not the tail

indicators.note: back says the pieces are read in reverse order

parts.note: as can mean so, as in 'as good' / 'so good'

indicators.note: the last letter is dropped from the word for fluffy

parts.note: fluffy means soft to the touch

explanation.surface: Admiring a large feline's fluffy back, apart from its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so' here is the word as, not a link; 'Big cat' is loose, as the fossa is a Madagascan cat-like carnivore rather than a true cat.
explanation.definitionFit: The Madagascan carnivore is a large cat-like predator, loosely called a big cat.

clue.text: Decorate without being clumsy

parts.note: to grace is to adorn or decorate
less can mean without, as in 'a year less a day'

explanation.surface: Someone does the decorating without being awkward about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking elegance or poise means being awkward and ungainly in movement.

clue.text: I slipped over having run on track

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the exclamation is read backwards

parts.note: oops is what you say when you slip up
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone stumbles while jogging along a path.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal's trail of droppings or footprints, followed by hunters, is a track.

clue.text: Squeaky-clean, thanks, committing no crimes when on the outside

indicators.note: on the outside means the sinless word wraps around thanks

parts.note: sinless means doing no wrong
ta is British informal for thanks

explanation.surface: A grateful ex-convict stays spotless while on the outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the outside' suggests life out of prison, but it is a containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Free from spots or blemishes, figuratively unblemished in reputation.

clue.text: Solid artefacts round cathedral mostly broken

parts.note: O is round in shape

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so the letters are rearranged
mostly means all but the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Solid objects lie around a cathedral that is largely in ruins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims cathedral to CATHEDRA, and 'broken' rearranges that to CTAHEDRA after O.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight-faced polyhedra are solid geometric figures, here as made objects.

clue.text: Stew over author regularly in a difficult situation

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the stew above the other letters

parts.note: a hotpot is a stew, notably the Lancashire dish

indicators.note: regularly takes alternate letters of author

explanation.surface: An author struggles over a stew.
explanation.definitionFit: A controversial issue too awkward to handle is a tricky problem.

clue.text: Fool about with musical in hedonistic existence

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a clod is a fool
Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A clown lives a life of pleasure via a musical.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian phrase for the sweet life describes self-indulgent luxury.

clue.text: Girl with old male expert dispensing tips for global dating status?

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

indicators.note: dispensing with tips means losing the first and last letters

parts.note: a pundit is an expert

explanation.surface: A girl and an older male expert discuss global dating status, like a dating app.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means in the year of the world, dating events from the Creation.

clue.text: John, wanting a single, is available

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the single letter goes

parts.note: the john is slang for a lavatory
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: John, looking for a single room, is free.
explanation.definitionFit: A property for rent is said to be available, the sign in the window offering it.

clue.text: Young, shallow, vacuous Arabian country reporter

parts.note: new means young, recent

indicators.note: vacuous means empty, so only the outer letters of shallow stay

parts.note: Oman is a country on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: A sneering description of a young journalist from an Arabian state.
explanation.definitionFit: A female journalist is a reporter of current affairs.

clue.text: Scandinavian, not the first to hold golf club

indicators.note: to hold means to contain the golf letter
not the first means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a Swede is from Sweden
G is golf in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: A Scandinavian who is not first holds a golf club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'golf club' looks like the definition, but golf gives G and club alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A lofted iron for short shots is a type of golf club.

clue.text: Turn and streak for an audience

indicators.note: for an audience means as heard by listeners

parts.note: a weal is a raised streak on the skin

explanation.surface: A performer turns and runs naked across the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to turn about, as soldiers wheel.

clue.text: Athlete, once in US, New Orleans sent back

indicators.note: sent back says those letters are read in reverse
in says the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A former athlete in America travels back to New Orleans.
explanation.definitionFit: Jesse Owens was the American sprinter who won four golds at the 1936 Olympics.

clue.text: Time to enter gorge, say

indicators.note: to enter means to go inside the gorging word

parts.note: to sate is to gorge, fill up

explanation.surface: Time to step into a ravine, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: To state is to say or declare.

clue.text: Chris, compared to Saviour, is thus eternal

parts.words: Chris, compared to Saviour, is thus
parts.note: the name Chris is the Saviour's title Christ with its final letter missing

explanation.surface: A man named Chris is likened to Christ and so becomes immortal.
explanation.walkthrough: Chris is Christ without its end letter T, so 'thus' describes the name as lacking an end.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasting forever without stopping is the sense of everlasting or eternal.

clue.text: About to come in on air, playing instrument

indicators.note: to come in means to be put inside the rearranged letters
playing means performing differently, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: ca, circa, means about

explanation.surface: Someone is about to come on air and play an instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' rearranges ON AIR to ORINA, and 'to come in' puts CA inside.
explanation.definitionFit: This small egg-shaped wind instrument with finger holes is a musical instrument.

clue.text: Prepare for something unpleasant — heavy metal?

definitions.meaning: to ... yourself is to brace for a nasty experience
a strong, dense iron alloy, playfully called a heavy metal

explanation.surface: Brace yourself: loud rock music is coming.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means bracing yourself; the noun is an iron alloy, heavy and metallic.

clue.text: Joint talk pompously put on my page

indicators.note: put on means placed after the other pieces

parts.note: cor! is an exclamation like my!
to orate is to speak pompously

explanation.surface: Someone holding forth pompously gets put onto a page.
explanation.definitionFit: Shared by a group acting together, as in a corporate decision.
